# MapLibre GL JS 5.24.0

Vendored from the official npm package `maplibre-gl@5.24.0` (https://www.npmjs.com/package/maplibre-gl/v/5.24.0).

- `maplibre-gl-csp.js`: CSP distribution, served locally.
- `maplibre-gl-csp-worker.js`: separate same-origin worker; no blob worker or unsafe-eval required.
- `maplibre-gl.css`: upstream styles.
- `LICENSE.txt`: original upstream license and third-party notices.

Only these four runtime/license files are publicly allowlisted. This README and package sources are not public assets. The tile services, attribution, request privacy and usage limits are described in [the project report](../../LOG_COVERAGE_REVIEW.md).
